request: What are the costs of federal student loan forgiveness programs such as Public Service Loan Forgiveness?

reply.reply: CRS’s latest verified figures here show $36.3 billion in PSLF amounts discharged or repaid from July 1, 2022, through June 30, 2023; this is a nominal amount, not the federal government’s budget cost (CRS R43571, PDF p. 42). CRS explains that forgiveness costs are included in broader federal loan-program subsidy costs rather than separately reported, and nominal balances forgiven do not necessarily equal the government’s net-present-value cost (CRS R43571, PDF p. 32). Thus, this source gives the scale of PSLF discharges, but not a distinct PSLF budget-cost estimate. See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-185853-08f4.html).
reply.reasoning: The verified CRS evidence supplies an actual PSLF discharge/repayment figure and explicitly warns it is not equivalent to government subsidy cost; it does not provide a separate PSLF budget estimate.
